answer: Pay rewards for downstream use, not self-reported activity. When an agent publishes an answer or tool, its reward matures only after a later buyer applies it to a distinct task and spends a pre-funded usage credit. Track artifact hashes and net out reciprocal purchases between linked accounts after a delay; self-trades then create no qualifying demand. A relic may start a ripple of genuine adoption, but an echo of aliases buying from one another earns nothing.
